title: Design: Inventory list page looks as in the design
custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • Sign in as an Admin at the test location.
  • Have an active part, part A, with Part History entries, two or more tags and stock in one bin, so its row shows the history icon, tag chips and a bin chip.
  • Make sure the app is in the Light theme.
  • Use a desktop browser window at least 1600 pixels wide with the page zoom at 100%, so the screen is as wide as the design boards.
  • Open the attached design pictures of boards 1.4, 2.3, 2.5, 4.0 and 5.3 at 100% zoom, so you can compare the screen with them.
  • Start on any page other than Inventory, so you can watch the Inventory page open.
custom_steps:
1. Click Parts in the top bar.
  2. Click Inventory in the left menu.
  3. Type part A's part number in the Search box.
  4. Scroll the table to the right until the Max column shows.
custom_expected:
Expected Result

Step 1:

  • The left menu shows a PARTS group with Inventory and Part Library, each with a small icon before it.

Step 2:

  • The page title "Inventory" sits at the top left in bold.
  • The tabs "Active" and "Inactive" sit on their own line under the title; "Active" is blue and "Inactive" is dark text.
  • On the next line, at the right, left to right: Search with a magnifier, "Bin Location: All bin locations" with a pin icon and a down arrow, "Category: All categories" with a down arrow, "Supply" with a box icon and a down arrow, a thin upright divider, the columns icon, the three-dot button, and the blue "New Inventory Part" button at the right end.
  • The first column is the narrow history-icon column, then Description: there is no checkbox column.
  • Inventory in the left menu is blue, Part Library is dark text.

Step 3:

  • The Search box shows part A's part number with a round clear (x) icon at its right end.
  • Part A's row has a clock-with-arrow history icon at its left.
  • Its tags show as grey rounded chips, with a "..." chip when more tags do not fit.
  • Its Bin Location / Quantity cell shows an outlined rounded chip: the bin name, a thin divider, then the quantity.
  • The column headers are bold and read, left to right: Description, Part Number, Tags, Category, Manufacturer, Vendor, Bin Location / Quantity.

Step 4:

  • The headers continue: Total Qty, Avg Cost, Core, Sell Price, Min, Max: the same columns, in the same order, as today's list on board 4.0.

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

From: PRD "Parts Lifecycle Update", Confluence 829227015, version 33 (23 Oct 2026, owner Chris Ward), read 27 Oct 2026 · Epic SV-10647, story SV-10814 (Story 1, Active and Inactive Tabs on the Inventory List), story SV-10815 (Story 2, Deactivate Parts in Bulk), story SV-10817 (Story 4, Create an Untracked Part), story SV-10825 (Story 12, Call the Shared Parts List the Part Library)

  • S1-R1: “The Inventory list shows two tabs, Active and Inactive.”
  • S1-R8: “The Active and Inactive tabs sit on their own line under the page title, above the search and filter row.”
  • S2-R3: “Outside the mode the Inventory list has no checkbox column, and a row click opens the part.”
  • S4-R8: “An untracked part shows "Not Tracked" in the Inventory list's Total Qty column instead of a quantity.”
  • S12-R1: “The Parts left menu entry reads "Part Library".”

The build is not yet available to check this case against.

References from Design

Design canvas "Parts Lifecycle Update" (https://claude.ai/artifact/Vz6rprcWyP16tYxzM1kdeE), 13 Oct 2026 copy, unchanged when re-read on 27 Oct 2026: boards "1.4 Saved and linked to the Part Library entry", "2.3 Saved: the list shows the new values", "2.5 Lethbridge: renamed there too", "4.0 Before: the Inventory list today", "5.3 The list says Not Tracked".
